source: A potential wreck or active threat. Move closer to reveal what it is.
translation: 可能是殘骸，也可能是威脅。靠近後才能確認。

source: Acquire {targetMetal} Metal and {targetElectronics} Electronics for Research Center module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal and {amountElectronics} Electronics.
translation: 取得研究中心模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬與 {targetElectronics} 電子零件。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬與 {amountElectronics} 電子零件。

source: Acquire {targetMetal} Metal for Farm module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal.
translation: 取得農場模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬。

source: Acquire {targetMetal} Metal for Metallurgy module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal.
translation: 取得冶金模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬。

source: Acquire {targetMetal} Metal for Recycling Station module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal.
translation: 取得回收站模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬。

source: Allows to repair squadrons directly during the space exploration and FTL travel phase.
translation: 可在太空探索與 FTL 航行期間直接修復中隊。

source: Also, these towers are somehow jamming our FTL computers, we have to destroy them, or we are stuck here forever.
translation: 另外，這些防禦塔似乎正在干擾我們的 FTL 電腦。必須摧毀它們，否則我們就會永遠困在這裡。

source: Ammo in the ship's magazine / magazine capacity.
translation: 艦上彈藥庫目前的彈藥量／容量上限。

source: An ancient artefact… and almost intact. Whoever built it may have understood things we’re only beginning to discover.
translation: 一件古代遺物……而且幾乎完好無損。建造它的文明，或許早已理解我們才剛開始探索的知識。

source: And remember, Commander, every new citizen increases our demand for food and water. The larger our colony grows, the more farms and recycling stations we'll need.
translation: 別忘了，指揮官，每增加一位居民，食物與水的需求就會上升。殖民地越大，需要的農場與回收站也就越多。

source: And you believe this beacon can lead us there?
translation: 你認為這枚信標能帶我們找到那裡？

source: Arrange selected squadrons into a line formation.
translation: 將所選中隊編成橫列隊形。

source: Arrange selected squadrons into a square formation.
translation: 將所選中隊編成方形隊形。

source: Arrange selected squadrons into an X formation.
translation: 將所選中隊編成 X 形隊形。

source: Arrange selected squadrons into an arrow formation.
translation: 將所選中隊編成箭形隊形。

source: Assigns a military crew and begins training. This module cannot operate until training is complete.
translation: 配置軍事人員並開始訓練。訓練完成前，此模組無法運作。

source: Boarding vessel. Latches onto a human hull and puts a landing party aboard, then returns to the fleet for a fresh one.
translation: 登艦作戰船艦。附著在人類艦船的船殼上，派遣登陸小隊登艦，然後返回艦隊補充新小隊。

source: Boosts mining efficiency of all miners in the system by 50% for 60 seconds. Each miner has a 50% chance to take heavy damage and lose its engines for 20 seconds. Can be used once per system.
translation: 使本星系所有採礦船的採礦效率提高 50%，持續 60 秒。每艘採礦船有 50% 機率遭受重創，且引擎失效 20 秒。每個星系只能使用一次。

source: Build the essentials. Repair what you can. Search the stars for what was lost.
translation: 建造必要設施，盡力修復艦船，並在群星之間尋找失落之物。

source: But those defence towers are still active. We can’t send anyone near the structure while its weapons are operational.
translation: 但那些防禦塔仍在運作。武器還能開火，就不能派人接近那座建築。

source: Can be salvaged for resources, functional equipment or other interesting stuff.
translation: 可回收資源、仍可使用的裝備，或其他有用的物品。

source: Cancel current orders for selected units.
translation: 取消所選單位目前的命令。

source: Chance to dodge an incoming shot. Depends on the squadron's combat mode.
translation: 閃避來襲攻擊的機率，會隨中隊的戰鬥模式而改變。

source: Chips, Cabels, Advanced parts that every geek needs
translation: 晶片、電纜與各種進階零件，科技迷的必需品。

source: Click and drag with the left mouse button to draw a selection box around your Mining Ships. Release to select them together and issue commands to the whole group.
translation: 按住滑鼠左鍵並拖曳，用選取框圈住採礦船。放開按鍵後即可同時選取，對整組船艦下達命令。

source: Click on Nuke button and launch Nuke on Asteroid. Move your ship in range if needed.
translation: 點擊核彈按鈕，向小行星發射核彈。必要時先將船艦移至射程內。

source: Click on dock button. The ship will find it's way to hangar.
translation: 點擊停靠按鈕，艦船就會自行返回機庫。

source: Click on guard button and left-click capital ship with your Squadron to guard it.
translation: 選取中隊後點擊護衛按鈕，再以滑鼠左鍵點擊主力艦，命令中隊護衛它。

source: Click on this text in this Mission Panel to locate its objective and move to the mission area. This works with most of non-tutorial objectives.
translation: 點擊任務面板中的這段文字，即可定位目標並將視角移至任務區域。大多數正式任務也能這樣操作。

source: Click on wreck button and save resource from wreck.
translation: 點擊殘骸按鈕，回收殘骸中的資源。

source: Click the Fast Forward button in UI Panel to speed up the game. It's useful when you're waiting for something to happen.
translation: 點擊介面上的快轉按鈕，加快遊戲速度。等待船艦抵達或事件發生時十分實用。

source: Collect ammo and unload it at the Main Ship.
translation: 收集彈藥，並卸載至主艦。
收集被摧毀艦船留下的貨物。

source: Collect cargo from near by wreck with your mining ship.
translation: 用採礦船收集附近殘骸中的貨物。

source: Commander! Our FTL engine seems to be malfunctioning!
translation: 指揮官！我們的 FTL 引擎似乎故障了！

source: Commander! We done what we could, but now we must focus on what’s left.
translation: 指揮官！我們已盡力而為，現在必須把心力放在還保有的事物上。

source: Commander, destroy the defence towers. Once the area is secure, we can send a salvage team to investigate.
translation: 指揮官，摧毀防禦塔。等周圍安全了，我們就能派回收小隊進去調查。

source: Commander, it is time to run our mandatory training. We’ll test our weapons and practise some manoeuvres. Wouldn’t want your skills to turn rusty.
translation: 指揮官，該進行例行訓練了。我們會測試武器並練習一些機動操作，可不能讓你的身手生疏了。

source: Commander, our FTL engine is prepared. We can escape this star system for good.
translation: 指揮官，FTL 引擎已就緒。我們終於能逃離這個星系了。

source: Commander, second ship just went dark!
translation: 指揮官，第二艘艦船剛剛失去訊號了！

source: Commander, there has been trouble among the fleet. Among the wreckage, we found an intact beacon core and someone claims to know where it leads.
translation: 指揮官，艦隊裡有些騷動。我們在殘骸中找到一枚完整的信標核心，有人聲稱知道它會指向哪裡。

source: Commander, there is an unidentified alien vessel near by. They're not showing any signs of hostility. In fact, they seem to be offering us something.
translation: 指揮官，附近有一艘身分不明的外星船艦。它們沒有表現出敵意，反而像是想賣些東西給我們。

source: Commander, there might be remnants of enemy alien ships. We must proceed with carefulness.
translation: 指揮官，這裡可能還有殘存的敵方外星艦船。我們必須謹慎行動。

source: Commander, this is an emergency. We are under an attack! We need your help in our colony. Use your FTL jump to get here immediately or we are doomed!
translation: 指揮官，情況緊急！我們遭到攻擊了！殖民地需要你的援助。立刻使用 FTL 躍遷趕來，否則我們就完了！

source: Commander, this is reckless. We have people to protect. Chasing a forgotten planet could lead us straight to our grave.
translation: 指揮官，這太魯莽了。我們還有人要保護。追逐一顆被遺忘的行星，可能只會把我們送進墳墓。

source: Commander, we can't afford to waste nukes like that. They're not exactly cheap. Try again!
translation: 指揮官，我們可經不起這樣浪費核彈，它們並不便宜。再試一次！

source: Commander, we can’t afford to waste nukes like that. They’re not exactly cheap. Try again!
translation: 指揮官，我們可不能這樣浪費核彈。這東西可不便宜，再試一次！

source: Commander, we found lechu coordinates! But it seems that the data is encypted and incomplete. I suggest we start try to decipher them.
translation: 指揮官，我們找到利丘的座標了！但資料似乎經過加密，而且不完整。我建議立即著手解密。

source: Commander, we must try to help anyone who is still alive!
translation: 指揮官，我們必須盡力救出還活著的人！

source: Commander, we're detecting an emergency transmission. It's being broadcast to all fleets.
translation: 指揮官，我們偵測到緊急通訊，正在向所有艦隊廣播。

source: Commander. Construct a new Flak module.
translation: 指揮官，建造一個新的防空砲模組。

source: Commander. We couldn't save the Behemoth… the pride of humanity, our finest ship.
translation: 指揮官，我們沒能救下貝希摩斯號……那是人類的驕傲，我們最優秀的艦船。
完成解密伺服器的研究。
恭喜你，指揮官！我們辦到了！

source: Construct Storage Module for storing more Raw Materials.
translation: 建造倉儲模組，以儲存更多原料。

source: Construct Supply Hold module for storing more Water.
translation: 建造補給艙模組，以儲存更多水。
